cases.strongest_supported_conclusion: The two-temperature-response mixture is a useful rate-transfer extension.
cases.quality_limits: One held20K/min ramp is not an independent material-lot test; two fitted channels do not identify two chemical species.
cases.recommended_improvement: Add a new independently measured ramp or batch, with orthogonal chemical evidence before interpreting channel identities.

tasks.scope: Source-fitted conversion excluded. Four development traces; one high-rate extrapolation confirmation. Audit exposed first four rows near zero of every trace.
tasks.calibration: Predict author-observed DSC conversion from temperature and imposed constant heating rate; no target history.
tasks.independent_unit: Complete heating-rate experiment; not independent material batches
tasks.comparison_policy: Each task separately; no cross-version averaging; best frozen alternative is diagnostic, never automatic reselection

cases.strongest_supported_conclusion: Nominal inverse-area scaling is a coarse recorded-channel reference.
cases.quality_limits: Unspecified acquisition gain and extreme devices preclude intrinsic resistance/yield claims.
cases.recommended_improvement: Resolve amplifier gain and measure actual junction dimensions; design die/wafer-held evaluation with retained defective devices.

tasks.scope: 19 dies on two wafers. Unknown acquisition gain/offset, nominal rather than measured area. Tail fits operationally define a response and may include defective junctions; all unambiguous devices retained.
tasks.calibration: No per-device response calibration. Current conversion V_gen/100 ohm is source-provided. Native response gain is not documented; endpoint is recorded-channel differential resistance, not intrinsic junction resistance.
tasks.independent_unit: complete wafer die: all junction widths and paired traces
tasks.comparison_policy: Each task separately; no cross-version averaging; best frozen alternative is diagnostic, never automatic reselection

cases.strongest_supported_conclusion: Established Stribeck/Hersey response transfers across people under the same liquid panel.
cases.quality_limits: Author-derived median friction is not raw telemetry; the pressure extension fails unseen-fluid transfer. Task prose retains a provisional count note.
cases.recommended_improvement: Use the native adapter inventory for exact counts; distinguish same-fluid person transfer from an independently registered unseen-fluid challenge.

tasks.scope: One substrate, eleven participants; transfer to reserved people under the same fluid panel, not other surfaces or contact systems. Fluids shared across participants.
tasks.calibration: 165 participant–fluid observations (check actual count); primary response is author-derived median CoF, not instantaneous raw telemetry. Source already reports the Stribeck collapse and hydrodynamic exponent. Area/hydration are separate measurements; author-fit Hersey coefficients cannot validate their own physics. Raw force/position files remain untouched.

cases.quality_limits: Conditional observed stiffness is not remaining useful life; survival/runout selection and the small number of specimens limit inference.
cases.recommended_improvement: Add censoring-aware lifetime endpoints only with complete failure/runout records and new whole-specimen confirmation.

tasks.scope: Six specimens from three cure profiles in one glass-fiber campaign, with declared cycles-10-to-20 initial calibration. Not a remaining-life, runout or new-material prediction.
tasks.calibration: E0 is the median native stiffness at cycles 10–20 for the same specimen; later stiffness and terminal cycle are unavailable to predictors.

cases.quality_limits: Flexible controls beat later physically motivated revisions; fitted slip and radial-coordinate effects are not universal closure constants.

cases.quality_limits: Same-device calibration is indispensable; no memory-retention or mechanism-specific transport claim follows.
cases.recommended_improvement: Test independent arrays/lots and explicitly measure how reduced characterization affects cost and reconstruction uncertainty.

cases.strongest_supported_conclusion: Calibrated wake-shape models supply a bounded field reconstruction task.

cases.recommended_improvement: Acquire multiple control repeats/tunnel conditions; distinguish raw line-of-sight measurements from interpolated uu products and score turbine-power effects independently.

tasks.independent_unit: whole control setting across turbines and downstream sections
